title: Nationwide Digital Banking Adoption Survey 2026
summary: A nationally representative survey of adults on how they use mobile wallets and bank apps, what stops them opening accounts online, and which fees put them off.

findings.text: 58% of adults used a mobile wallet to pay or send money in the past month (base n=2,400).
Among adults aged 18-29, 74% used a mobile wallet in the past month (base n=610).
Fees on transfers to other banks were cited by 41% of adults as a reason to keep cash (base n=2,400).
Being asked for documents they do not have was cited by 36% of adults who had not opened a bank account online (base n=1,150).
29% of adults said they would open a savings account online if it took under ten minutes (base n=2,400).
In Mindanao, 47% cited fees on transfers to other banks as a reason to keep cash (base n=520).
